lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走近，没有声音。
lines.en: I cross the leaves without a sound.

lines.zh: 条纹在暗处分开又合上。
lines.en: My stripes part and rejoin in the dark.
Low to the ground, I creep.

lines.zh: 我沿着院墙走，爪子不响。
lines.en: I walk the garden wall, claws silent.

lines.zh: 我在树与树之间穿过去。
lines.en: I slip between tree and tree.
My tail brushes the grass. Lightly.
I circle in, closer each time.

lines.zh: 我的步子比你的心跳慢。
lines.en: My pace is slower than your pulse.

lines.zh: 我走到你刚点起的火边。
lines.en: I reach the fire you just lit.

lines.zh: 落叶堆里，我踩出一点响。
lines.en: In the leaf pile, one faint crunch.
I never run. Running would warn you.
I pass along the side of your house.
Crouched, my eyes never leave you.

lines.zh: 我伏在草丛里，只露眼睛。
lines.en: In the grass, only my eyes show.
I lick a paw and wait.

lines.zh: 你听见呼噜声，那不一定是猫。
lines.en: A rumble. Not necessarily a cat.
I crouch beyond your fence.
I crouch in the corner, watching the hall.
I lie almost flat against the earth.

lines.zh: 我在等太阳完全落下去。
lines.en: I wait for the sun to go entirely.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，你听不到。
lines.en: My breathing is too soft to hear.

lines.zh: 我一跳出来，就离你很近了。
lines.en: One leap and I'm already close.

lines.zh: 这个位置，能看清你的窗户。
lines.en: From here I see your window.
Still, and the wood goes still.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨爪子，在树皮上。
lines.en: I sharpened my claws on bark.
Your lamp still burns. No hurry.
Your door isn't shut tight.
Do not run. It excites me.

lines.zh: 你身上有火和铁的味道。
lines.en: You smell of fire and iron.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，只有我的眼在亮。
lines.en: In the dark, only my eyes shine.

lines.zh: 你刚才回头看的方向，是我。
lines.en: The direction you checked was me.
I entered this yard first.
You stand very straight. Rigid.

lines.zh: 我知道你手里有几件武器。
lines.en: I know how many weapons you carry.
Keep your hand out of the grass.
I crouch low, tail sweeping the floor.
I have been watching your neck.
Your door is open. I pushed it.
You've shrunk back like a small animal.
Raise your sword. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我已经记住了你的路线。
lines.en: I have your route memorized.
Walking at night is dangerous.
The grass behind you just moved.
I wait for you to turn.
You cast two shadows.
You raise the lamp and see my teeth.
I growl and give half a block.
You hit my shoulder. Not bad.
A red line in my fur.
I do not cry out. I focus.
You will pay for that.
I flatten and gather force.
My claws dig into the soil.
Pain makes me want to pounce.

lines.zh: 你听见我的低吼变调了。
lines.en: My growl changes pitch.
All four legs are planted; I haven't given ground.
Meat? Put it down. Do not hand it over.

lines.zh: 我跳出来的时候，你来不及叫。
lines.en: When I pounce, you won't have time to scream.

lines.zh: 你拿食物哄我，真是可笑。
lines.en: You coax me with food. Amusing.

lines.zh: 我吃的不一定是你给的。
lines.en: What I eat may not be your gift.
Three steps back, then I approach.
Toss me the meat in your hand.
Your hand is too close.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢自己捕的东西。
lines.en: I prefer what I catch.
You wave the meat. I do not move.
Do not offer food for your life.
You bumped into me. Unlucky.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看起来更沉。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我就知道你的重量。
lines.en: One touch and I know your weight.
You pull back. I stay crouched.

lines.zh: 爪子在你靴子上留了痕。
lines.en: My claws left a mark on your boot.

lines.zh: 我没有扑，只是让你撞上。
lines.en: I did not pounce. You walked into me.
You are thrown against your fence.
Do not press against me. I get restless.

lines.zh: 我的毛很硬，你摸到了吧。
lines.en: My fur is coarse. You felt it.
One collision costs you half a life.
I am the only one in this wood.
These stripes need no companion.
That question comes too close.

lines.zh: 我的同类在更深的林子里。
lines.en: My kind are deeper in the trees.

lines.zh: 别用这种问题引我开口。
lines.en: Do not bait me with that.
I prefer to walk alone.
Say it again and I pounce.
Tiger business is not for you.
Worry about surviving instead.

lines.zh: 这个话题，我用尾巴扫掉了。
lines.en: My tail swept that topic away.
I inspect what you dropped.
This meat is mine.
I hook it over with a claw.
Do not bend to pick that up.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我咬了一口。
lines.en: I bit what was on the ground.
Your arrow fell in the grass.
I carry it, then drop it.
All in this wood belongs to me.
Your things smell of rust.
Do not grab. I bite.
I see your back.
I flatten; my hind legs coil.
No warning this time.
Hear the growl? Time to run.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经踩在你影子上。
lines.en: My paw is already on your shadow.
The grass leans one way.
I am within three steps.

lines.zh: 你身上只有一件厚衣服。
lines.en: Only one thick garment on you.
Your sweat drifts from behind the door.
I measured this leap.
Retreat and the distance shrinks.
I set a paw on your shadow.
Do not run into the grass.
Reaching for a weapon. Too slow.
Now I move.

lines.zh: 你没听见我，这是你的错。
lines.en: You did not hear me. Your fault.
I tighten the circle.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就近一步。
lines.en: Each step back, I take one in.
My tail has stopped moving.

lines.zh: 你每吸一口气，我就近一点。
lines.en: With every breath you take, I come closer.
Your fire lights three blocks.
The rustling comes closer.
This time I do not hide behind the tree.
That shield is thin.
I have picked my landing spot.
You back away. Good.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收起来了，现在。
lines.en: My claws are out now.

lines.zh: 你听见你身后的草在响。
lines.en: Hear the grass behind you?
One lantern out. Not by me.
Five blocks. One leap.
I wait for you to walk in.
A feline frame, pressed very low.

lines.zh: 你的护甲有一处是软的。
lines.en: Your armor has one soft spot.
I wait for you to set the lamp down.

lines.zh: 这条小径只通向一个方向。
lines.en: This path runs one way.
The last step. I stop counting.
My claws cross your chest.
I take you down and pin your shoulder.
My teeth close on your forearm.
One paw and your ears ring.
Not full strength. Only play.

lines.zh: 你的血味，我隔着走廊就闻到。
lines.en: I smell your blood down the corridor.
Your clothes split along one line.
I hit your knee and you kneel.
That falls on your nape.
I step back to watch you rise.
You stopped the claws, not the teeth.

lines.zh: 我的低吼贴着你的耳朵。
lines.en: My growl is right at your ear.

lines.zh: 这院子里的草压平了一片。
lines.en: A patch of grass is flattened.
You roll two blocks before stopping.
Again and I press harder.
Your sweat smells stronger than before.
A pair of eyes in the grass.
A low sound at the treeline.

lines.zh: 我在你的篱笆外蹲下了。
lines.en: I crouch outside your fence.
Fresh claw prints in the leaves.
The wind stopped because I am near.

lines.zh: 我的条纹和树影混在一起。
lines.en: My stripes blend with the shadows.
Every bird has gone quiet.

lines.zh: 你听见草丛被压的声音。
lines.en: Grass crushing under weight.

lines.zh: 我从林子里慢慢走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the wood.
Your dog has stopped barking.

lines.zh: 我在你的田埂上留了印。
lines.en: I left prints on your field ridge.
Stripes moving in the moonlight.
I lie low and let you move first.
Tonight the wood is mine.

lines.zh: 你听见很近的一声呼气。
lines.en: A breath, very near.

lines.zh: 我踩过你昨天砍的木头。
lines.en: I step over the log you cut.
A new line of paw prints outside.
I crouch below your window.
Something follows you.
I have come. Quietly.
Fire sears my back; fur curls.

lines.zh: 从树上落下，我翻了个身。
lines.en: Off the tree, I twist and land.
Water to my belly; I swim poorly.
The blast throws me into the fence.
A hole in this tiger hide.
Magic numbs my claws.
Too long hungry and my steps drift.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的眼睛白得刺眼。
lines.en: In lightning, my eyes burn white.
In the abyss, I am still falling.
